$comment: Shipped-bundle budgets in KiB -- see scripts/quality/bundle-budget-gate.mjs.
Unlike tools/quality/quality-baseline.json these are NOT auto-recorded: a bundle may
legitimately grow when a feature lands, so raising a number must be a
deliberate line in a diff with a reason, not a regenerated file.
Seeded from the 2026-09-03 build with roughly 5% headroom.
Per-capability-profile budgets for the hardened composition builds
(ownership.md 4.6). Unlike `apps`, these are measured against
`apps/pages/dist-profiles/<name>`, which only exists after
`pnpm --filter @opensesame/pages build:profile --profile
capability-profiles/<name>.json --mode hardened`. The gate measures a
profile when its directory is there and prints a skip notice when it is
not, so a checkout that never ran a profile build still passes.
2026-09-22: seeded from the first real hardened builds of minimal-local
and family-local at /OpenSesame/, plus ~5% headroom. The two measure
identically today (total 2290.5 KiB, javascript 1855.1, javascriptGzip

note: The installable offline PWA (ADR 0090). Its service worker precaches
every byte counted in `total`, so this is what a device downloads on
install, once, over whatever connection it has.
83% of that total is one file: the client-core Wasm sync engine at
~12.5 MiB. It dominates `total` and `largestAsset` while contributing
nothing to `javascriptGzip`, which is why both are budgeted -- a JS
regression would be invisible inside a 15 MiB total.
